title: {Syn} AlphaProof Reached Silver-Level IMO Performance
content:
In 2024, Google DeepMind reported that AlphaProof and AlphaGeometry 2 solved International Mathematical Olympiad problems at a silver-medal level.

The milestone combined formal reasoning and geometry-focused systems, pointing toward AI that can work with proof-like structure rather than only natural-language answers.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
